evaluation.GSO: 93 validation objects x4 views x5 pitch bins(0,15,30,45,60)=1860 images; independent monocular predictions
evaluation.real_single: DiLiGenT10 and LUCES14 objects, one frozen lighting image per object
evaluation.real_10_lighting: DiLiGenT100 and LUCES140 images,10 independent monocular lighting-image predictions per object, then object macro averaging; no joint10-input inference and no claim of equivalence to joint multi-light methods
evaluation.normal_metric: Bilinear resize raw prediction to native GT resolution if needed, normalize prediction and GT on valid pixels, angular MAE; average per-view errors within object, then objects, then equally weighted GSO pitch bins
evaluation.FM_reduction: Mean of errors from8 independent inference draws, not averaged normal vectors or a vector ensemble; these are not8 training seeds
evaluation.MoGe_and_E3: deterministic normal-only inference,1 draw; verified exact raw-normal parity with full model on9 aspect/scale acceptance cases
evaluation.orientation: D2/E models identity; native MoGe/E3 use -I to registered common camera convention
evaluation.primary_GT: frozen original GT normal and mask; alternate face/crease45 normals remain diagnostics
evaluation.boundary_primary: GT adjacent normal angle >20 degrees, dilated radius2 pixels and intersected with valid mask; macro aggregation over images/objects with non-empty boundary bands, then equal pitch bins
evaluation.up_region: largest absolute GT normal component is positive y; Z signed error pooled by up-region pixels separately per pitch bin
evaluation.coarse_condition: E2 caches generated from RGB only at native512, transformed to common256,unit-normalized,FP16-stored and re-normalized; GT never used to generate conditions
evaluation.residual_initialization: Initial E2 equals the processed256 condition; it does not necessarily equal native-resolution MoGe-L output on real GT. See processing_control.json.
evaluation.E2_changes_relative_D2: Extra3 normal-input components AND coarse+zero-initialized-residual output parameterization. Gaussian start,linear path,Xn endpoint and single-step inference retained. Loss applied before final normalization.

efficiency.compute_precision: FM BF16; MoGe/E3 FP16; FP32 stored parameters; TF32 disabled
efficiency.statistic: median synchronized wall-clock forward latency; separate CUDA-event median
efficiency.included: GPU-resident model-native computation; E2 includes online MoGe normal generation + FM, no cached-condition shortcut
efficiency.input: MoGe RGB512; FM RGB/noise256 and canonical DINO518; MoGe max3600 encoder tokens vs FM prior1369
efficiency.OOM: Every fixed batch reports explicit status; no adaptive substitution
efficiency.end_to_end_note: These are pure model-forward numbers, not the earlier read/write-inclusive end-to-end table; new E fits have no new read/write-inclusive E2E measurement in this export.

scope: Aggregate completed results, effective recipes and reproducibility hashes only. No raw data, sample records, predictions or weights.
